La magia de Buenos Aires esta a la vuelta de la esquina, tomándose un "cortado" en la biela, un cafe de mas de 100 años, mientras miramos un ombu centenario y una pareja que baila tango en plaza francia. Visitando el cementerio de la recoleta que es mas un museo que un lugar para el descaso eterno, Es degustar el mejor malbec del mundo junto a un bife de lomo increíble, es caminar por las calles  y ver los mejores accesorios de cuero que hemos imaginado toda nuestra vida, recorrer una avenida llena de arboles violetas y estar rodeados de mansiones del siglo XIX.
Es estar en medio del rosedal, un parque mágico que hace que te olvides de la ciudad por un momento o la paz que transmite el jardin japonés. Buenos Aires es Europa sin dejar de ser America, es ver como lo antiguo vive en perfecta armonía con lo moderno y como en cada rincón aparece un sitio interesante para ser descubierto.
Intento que los huéspedes sientan el lugar un poco cómo su hogar y espero se lleven un buen recuerdo de la estadía.

Built around 1840, the house was totally renovated in order to adapt it to receiving tango guests from around the world. This was an undertaking by the Banchero family who are closely involved with tango and its many expressions. The house is colonial in style, the arrangement of rooms being typical of its period, side by side in a row and all facing a patio, or, as in this case, a patio with a lush garden of plants and flowers.
I'm a real porteño, who has a heart for the tango and all the historical things that come with this culture. Therefore I bought this fantastic colonial house in the heart of the pittoresk San Telmo. I studied music and already on a young age I was interested in tango. As a professional singer I travelled all over the world, now I dedicate myself more to composing and local projects to divide the tango culture. I like to spend time in nature, more specific in a kayak. I have a special project in El Tigre, the delta area near Buenos Aires where I started to built up a centre for watersports acitivities and ecological developments. Built around 1840, the house was totally renovated in order to adapt it to receiving tango guests from around the world. This was an undertaking by the Banchero family who are closely involved with tango and its many expressions. The house is colonial in style, the arrangement of rooms being typical of its period, side by side in a row and all facing a patio, or, as in this case, a patio with a lush garden of plants and flowers.
I'm a real porteño, who has a heart for the tango and all the historical things that come with this culture. Therefore I bought this fantastic colonial house in the heart of the pittoresk San Telmo. I studied music and already on a young age I was interested in tango. As a professional singer I travelled all over the world, now I dedicate myself more to composing and local projects to divide the tango culture. I like to spend time in nature, more specific in a kayak. I have a special project in El Tigre, the delta area near Buenos Aires where I started to built up a centre for watersports acitivities and ecological developments. On Sundays I like to do a real Argentinian parilla with friends and family, as you can see on the picture. If you want to get to know me better, please come and visit me in the house!

Limpiamos todas las habitaciones siguiendo las listas de tareas específicas para cada una de ellas.
Proporcionamos productos de limpieza adicionales por si necesitas limpiar durante la estancia.
Cumplimos con las leyes locales, incluidas todas las directrices de seguridad o limpieza.
